name: Order

Data from barcode
Build SELECT
func:
msg.payload = `
WITH UniqueItems AS (
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(A.ART_ARTICOLO)) AS Item,
        A.ART_DES AS Description,
        A.ART_DISP AS Available,
        A.ART_GIAC AS Stock,
        B.SCO_UDC AS Tray,
        B.SCO_TIPOSCOMP AS Compartment,
        B.SCO_POSI AS Position,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LTRIM(RTRIM(A.ART_ARTICOLO)) ORDER BY B.SCO_POSI) AS rn
    FROM
        [DESKTOP-P11CIDM\\SQLEXPRESS].SYSTOREDB.dbo.DAT_ARTICOLI A
    LEFT JOIN
        [DESKTOP-P11CIDM\\SQLEXPRESS].SYSTOREDB.dbo.DAT_SCOMPART B
        ON LTRIM(RTRIM(A.ART_ARTICOLO)) = B.SCO_ARTICOLO
    WHERE
        LTRIM(RTRIM(A.ART_ARTICOLO)) <> ''
        AND LTRIM(RTRIM(A.ART_DES)) <> ''
        AND LTRIM(RTRIM(A.ART_DES)) <> 'Non significativo'
        AND A.ART_ARTICOLO IS NOT NULL
        AND A.ART_DES IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    Item,
    Description,
    Available,
    Stock,
    Tray,
    Compartment,
    Position
FROM UniqueItems
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY Item;
`;
return msg;
